content:
ophelia: Quick personal update — two things rolled into one week: I accepted an internal promotion to Senior Staff Engineer 🎉 and we’re expecting a baby in late September 👶💛! Wanted to share here because you all are my people and I’ll definitely need advice.
noah: WHAT. omg congrats x1000!!! this is huge. bring all the baby and promotion stories pls. :tada::confetti_ball:
liz: +1 congrats!!! Team celebratory lunch? I volunteer to bring cupcakes. 🧁
marta: Oh my gosh lovely news both of them — obvs we need a tiny human onesie with the Redwood logo. 🤣
sam: Congrats Ophelia!! Do you want to do a combined lunch + small shower? People-ops can help with logistics if we want an office thing.
ophelia: Love that. Maybe a Friday afternoon 3pm thing? Small gifts only, no pressure. I made a quick sign-up sheet: https://tinyurl.com/ophelia-celebrate (just placeholder)
liz: Poll: Cake / Cupcakes / Donuts / Mini empanadas? React below with the emoji you prefer.
noah: :cupcake:
marta: :doughnut:
sam: :cake: but I will eat any of the above
people-ops-bot: Congrats Ophelia! :party_popper: I created a Calendar hold for a "Ophelia — Promo + Baby" celebration on 2026-09-18 15:00 PDT and a short RSVP form. RSVP link: https://forms.company/celebrate-ophelia
ophelia: Thanks team — also if anyone has a favorite pediatrician or baby gear recs DM me. Also might need help with on-call swaps closer to September.
noah: I can cover shifts, DM me when the schedule is up.
liz: I have an ergo recommendation and a stroller rec, will drop a thread with links.
marta: Also I made a tiny Google doc for gift ideas + shipping address (no pressure) — will add to the sign-up sheet above.
sam: Bringing confetti and a ridiculous party hat. :party_hat:
ophelia: You are all the best. Honestly feeling so grateful. Thanks for the love. ❤️
people-ops-bot: Note: Please remember to follow Redwood gift policy for teammate celebrations. If you'd like People Ops to coordinate a team gift, react with :handshake:.
liz: :handshake:
noah: :thumbsup:
marta: :raised_hands:
